standard_prerequisites: rig-closed primes and the localization B_{f} of adic rings with prime q' over q (lemma-rig-closed-point-in-localization of the same chapter)
the equivalence characterization of rig-closed primes via finite residue field extensions (lemma-rig-closed-point-relative of the same chapter)
the residue field kappa of B/q is a finitely generated algebra over A/a (lemma-rig-closed-point-relative-residue-field of the same chapter)
the Hilbert Nullstellensatz form: a field finitely generated over a domain becomes finite after inverting a suitable element (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-field-finite-type-over-domain)
core_obligations: Prove that for an adic topologically finite type arrow varphi : A -> B of WAdm^Noeth and a rig-closed prime q of B, there exists f in A mapping to a unit in B/q such that in the localized diagram A_{f} -> B_{f} the primes q' over q and p' over p satisfy the equivalent conditions of lemma-rig-closed-point-relative, i.e., p' is rig-closed
proof_roadmap: The description of q' is given by the localization lemma; the content is choosing f so that dim of the completion of A_f at p' equals 1.
By the equivalence characterization this means the residue field kappa of B/q is finite over the reduction of (A_f)^wedge, which is (A/a)_f.
The residue field lemma makes A/a -> kappa a finite type algebra homomorphism, and the Nullstellensatz provides f in A, a unit in kappa, making kappa finite over (A/a)_f, which finishes the proof.
difficulty_reason: H3: a localization argument whose content is the Nullstellensatz choice of the inverting element.
